name: getUserPersonalChatMessages
description: Use this method to get the last messages from the personal chat (i.e., the chat currently added to their profile) of a given user. On success, an Array of [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) objects is returned.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of messages to return; 1-20
